notes.subject: plate
notes.text: White front plates and yellow rear plates, in both long and tall shapes.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: In the capital area a unique white Google car with square mirrors and a boxy look is visible, found nowhere else.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Most national park coverage uses a similar car with a black bar across the front; often the car is not visible at all.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Very red soil nearly everywhere; even paved roads often have a red, purple or pink tinge.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Small one-storey houses behind tall walls, often topped with barbed wire, along narrow unpaved streets.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Taxi buses with a blue blocky pattern on the sides are common in the capital.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: The only paved road outside the capital has white outer lines and a yellow centre line, with little red tinge.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The capital is very hilly; rounds without visible hills are rare.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: The city centre has paved roads with black-and-white curbs and many multi-storey buildings.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The nearby lakeside town feels emptier and greener, with fancier houses and more street signs.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The northeastern park is wide savannah with mountains in most directions, and a distinctive range to the east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The northwestern park has low dirt barriers beside the roads; palms in the north of it are a strong hint.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: The western forest park has a very wide dirt road through dense tropical forest, plus small forest roads and paths.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The southwestern park is the driest coverage, with dried-out grass and hilly, not mountainous, terrain.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Two small, very humid forest paths with water drops on the lens.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: One of the few places with brown or grey dirt, tree-like cacti and water-filled craters in the north.
